content.title: Validate IssueDetailPage fixes against e2e suite

content.description:
Validate the IssueDetailPage fixes:
- Run the full phase2 e2e suite — all 4 previously-failing tests ('navigates from list to detail page', 'navigates back from detail to list', 'displays issue title and ID', 'inline edit title') must now pass.
- Confirm no regressions in phase1/phase3/phase4 suites.
- Verify the back link, ID display, and inline title edit behave as expected in the UI.

Report pass/fail with details. Do NOT fix issues yourself — report them.

content.reason: Blocker issue mqe054ells transitioned to done

content.content: Status-loop reset: this validation task was in-progress since 2026-06-14 with no comment and no activity — appears the webapp-validator crashed/stalled mid-task. Resetting to todo so the work loop can re-hand it to webapp-validator. No partial results were reported.

Validation complete. All acceptance criteria met.

## Results

**Phase 2 — the 4 previously-failing IssueDetailPage tests (all PASS):**
- ✓ 'navigates from list to detail page'
- ✓ 'navigates back from detail to list'
- ✓ 'displays issue title and ID'
- ✓ 'inline edit title'

Back link, ID display, and inline title edit behave as expected in the UI.

**No regressions in other phases:**
- Phase 1: 7/7 passed
- Phase 2: 53/55 passed (2 flaky failures — see below)
- Phase 3: 52/52 passed
- Phase 4: 38/38 passed (includes known BUG-1/BUG-2 tests asserting current buggy behavior)

**About the 2 phase2 failures:** 'shows empty state when no issues match filters' and 'change status via dropdown' failed in the full-suite run, but both PASS when run in isolation. These are the known flaky shared-state ordering failures tracked in PM epic mqdzlo4ia8 (Deliverable C, up to 3 such failures expected per full run) — NOT regressions from the IssueDetailPage fixes.

Total: 150 tests pass across all phases. The IssueDetailPage fixes are verified working.
